# truenas_api_key (Data Source)

Fetches a TrueNAS API key by name. Never exposes the plaintext key value: api_key.query does not return it, so there is nothing for this data source to surface (see the truenas_api_key resource for the create-time-only key attribute).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) API key name to look up.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC3339 UTC timestamp of when the API key was created.
- `expires_at` (String) RFC3339 UTC expiration timestamp, or null if the key never expires.
- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the API key.
- `local` (Boolean) Whether this API key is for local system use only.
- `revoked` (Boolean) Whether the API key has been revoked and is no longer valid.
- `username` (String) Local username that owns this API key.
